groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.716% and the 10Y at 4.986%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -0.76% over five sessions and -4.45% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.95% at about $115.61, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-12/100, 62% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

The key confirmation remains the interaction between Treasury yields and semiconductor leadership. A sustained 10Y break above roughly 5.00–5.05% alongside weakening chips would materially weaken the setup; easing yields with stronger semiconductor participation would improve it.

paragraphs: QQQ is +1.11% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -12/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -30 → now -12; open +22 → now -12 (deteriorated 34 points).

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are supportive: Previous regular-session close · SOX +2.82% | Nasdaq +0.83% | SOX vs Nasdaq +1.99 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +2.02 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +1.91 pp. Breadth are mixed: After-hours · After-hours breadth: 15/42 advancing (36%) · 27 declining · 0 flat.
